name: falling-text
description: Marketing headline whose words fall with a physics-like tumble on click, hover, auto, or scroll, with semantic highlights and a static reduced-motion reading.
purpose: Turns a short landing line into a gravity beat so highlighted claims stay readable while the rest of the sentence drops into place.
bestFor: campaign heroes that need a kinetic headline
editorial landings that can afford a playful line
avoidFor: forms or task UI where falling copy would compete with controls
